findings.highlight: Mihoko refused to go to school
findings.evidenceJa: 美穂子が進学しないって言い出した理由
findings.explanation: 進学しない means Mihoko says she will not advance to higher education. The translation turns that future educational decision into refusal to attend school, changing the unresolved problem being discussed.
findings.japanese:
「その、解決できてない問題…
美穂子が進学しないって言い出した理由について、です」
findings.todokanai: "Um, about that problem that couldn't be solved…? I want to tell you the reason why Mihoko refused to go to school."

findings.highlight: Mihoko's isolating herself more desperately than she has up until now
findings.evidenceJa: だから、美穂子にとって今までよりも深刻なんです
findings.explanation: Koharu says the matter is more serious for Mihoko than before because Koharu hurt her. The translation invents intensified self-isolation as Mihoko's specific behavior, exceeding both the source and the approved note's attribution of this causal account to Koharu.
findings.japanese:
「わたしが、美穂子のこと傷つけちゃったんです。
だから、美穂子にとって今までよりも深刻なんです」
findings.todokanai: "I ended up hurting Mihoko. That's why Mihoko's isolating herself more desperately than she has up until now…"

findings.highlight: her heart and soul should be heavily wounded
findings.evidenceJa: 心も身体も、ボロボロに傷つけられたはずなのに
findings.explanation: The source explicitly pairs mind/heart with body. 'Heart and soul' duplicates the psychological half and erases bodily injury from Haruki's guilt after the sexual relationship.
findings.japanese:
それなのに…
心も身体も、ボロボロに傷つけられたはずなのに…
findings.todokanai: And yet… even though her heart and soul should be heavily wounded by all that…

findings.highlight: I really hope my body manages to suppress such a temptation
findings.evidenceJa: その衝動を抑えなくちゃならない方の身にもなってくれ
findings.explanation: Haruki asks for sympathy for the person who has to suppress the urge to embrace her. The translation makes suppression something he hopes his body will manage, removing his deliberate restraint and the complaint directed at the sleeping Koharu.
findings.japanese:
…抱きしめたくて、
その衝動を抑えなくちゃならない方の身にもなってくれ。
findings.todokanai: …I want to hug her, though I really hope my body manages to suppress such a temptation.
